questions.question: On this day in 1919, who made history by taking her seat as the very first female Member of Parliament in the UK House of Commons?
questions.explanation: Nancy Astor, Viscountess Astor, became the first woman to physically sit in the House of Commons after her election in 1919.
questions.context:
On this day in 1919: Lady Astor is elected as a Member of the Parliament of the United Kingdom. She is the first woman to sit in the House of Commons. (Countess Markievicz, the first to be elected, refused to sit.)
Nancy Astor, Viscountess Astor (British politician (1879–1964)): Nancy Witcher Langhorne Astor, Viscountess Astor was an American-born British politician who was the first woman seated as a Member of Parliament (MP), serving from 1919 to 1945. Astor was born in Danville, Virginia, and raised in Greenwood, Virginia.

questions.question: Which upcoming Marvel Cinematic Universe film, directed by the Russo brothers, features Robert Downey Jr. portraying Doctor Doom?
questions.explanation: Robert Downey Jr. returns to the Marvel Cinematic Universe to play main villain Doctor Doom in Avengers: Doomsday.
questions.context: Avengers: Doomsday (Upcoming Marvel Studios film): Avengers: Doomsday is an upcoming American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics superhero team the Avengers. Produced by Marvel Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is intended to be the sequel to Avengers: Endgame (2019) and the 39th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, and written by Stephen McFeely and Michael Waldron, the film features an ensemble cast led by Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom.

questions.question: Which English rock, blues and jazz singer achieved a top-ten hit in 1977 with the song 'Pearl's a Singer'?
questions.explanation: Elkie Brooks earned a top-ten UK single with 'Pearl's a Singer' in the late 1970s following her tenure in bands like Dada and Vinegar Joe.
questions.context: Elkie Brooks (English singer (born 1945)): Elkie Brooks is an English rock, blues and jazz singer. She was a vocalist with the bands Dada and Vinegar Joe, and later became a solo artist. She gained her biggest success in the late 1970s and 1980s, releasing 13 UK Top 75 singles, and reached the top ten with "Pearl's a Singer", "Sunshine After the Rain", "Fool (1981), and "No More the Fool" (1986). She has been nominated twice for the Brit Awards.

questions.question: Which professional motorcycle racer achieved eight of his first ten Grand Prix World Championships in the premier MotoGP class?
questions.explanation: Spanish road racer Marc Márquez has accumulated ten Grand Prix titles, including eight top-tier MotoGP class championships.
questions.context: Marc Márquez (Spanish motorcycle racer (born 1993)): Marc Márquez Alentà is a Spanish Grand Prix motorcycle road racer who races for the Ducati Lenovo Team in MotoGP. He previously raced for Honda's factory team from 2013 to 2023, and for the Ducati satellite team Gresini Racing in 2024. Widely considered one of the greatest motorcycle racers of all time, he has won 10 Grand Prix World Championships, including eight in the MotoGP class.

questions.question: Which general anatomical term describes a flexible body framework maintained purely by fluid pressure inside an organism?
questions.explanation: A hydroskeleton relies on hydrostatic pressure from internal body fluids to maintain structural shape, unlike endoskeletons or rigid exoskeletons.
questions.context: Skeleton (Part of the body that forms the supporting structure): A skeleton is the structural frame that supports the body of most animals. There are several types of skeletons, including the exoskeleton, which is a rigid outer shell that holds up an organism's shape; the endoskeleton, a rigid internal frame to which the organs and soft tissues attach; and the hydroskeleton, a flexible internal structure supported by the hydrostatic pressure of body fluids.
